subject: Request: CAIQ mapping + artifact escrow and control ownership plan
messages:
From: Eleanor Rigby <eleanor.rigby@riverside-audit.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ mapping + artifacts for upcoming audit (Riverside / AcmeHealth)

Hi Sofia / Mike,

Riverside is scheduling AcmeHealth's CAIQ review week of 2027-08-15. To prepare, please provide the following by COB 2027-08-10: the completed CAIQ spreadsheet (with control-level mappings to Redwood controls), a list of artifact filenames and owners, and any system/network diagrams relevant to scope.

Separately, AcmeHealth has requested that a subset of artifacts (system diagrams, encryption key rotation records, and long-term retention logs) be placed in an escrow-style secure repository for audit review. Can Redwood confirm whether you can host these artifacts in a secure ShareFile folder with restricted access and a signed artifact-escrow addendum? If so, please share the access link and a point of contact.

Gracefully,
Eleanor Rigby
Senior Auditor, Riverside Compliance
attachments: CAIQ-template-2027.xlsx (requested format)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Rigby <eleanor.rigby@riverside-audit.com>, Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ mapping + artifacts for upcoming audit (Riverside / AcmeHealth)

Thanks, Eleanor — got it.

Plan:
- We will deliver an annotated CAIQ (spreadsheet) with a control->Redwood-control mapping and a short justification column for each response.
- We will also provide an artifact index (filename, owner, retention window) and upload approved artifacts to a secure ShareFile folder with restricted links for Riverside reviewers.
- Karthik will own technical control artifacts and Marissa will coordinate any customer-facing operational artifacts.

Action items (owners & tentative ETAs):
- Karthik Iyer: produce annotated CAIQ draft and core infra artifacts (sys diagram, rotation logs) — ETA 2027-08-04. (attachment: redwood_caiq_template.xlsx)
- Marissa Cole: consolidate operational artifacts and create control-owners index (attachment: control-owners.csv) — ETA 2027-08-05.
- Sofia Ivanova: review & package, prepare ShareFile folder and DocuSign artifact-escrow addendum — ETA 2027-08-06.

Eleanor — can you confirm the exact artifact list that must be escrowed (you mentioned system diagrams, key rotation records, retention logs). Also confirm whether Riverside needs time-limited access or additional attestations.

Sofia
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_caiq_template.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ mapping + artifacts for upcoming audit (Riverside / AcmeHealth)

Looping in owners and starting collection. Quick owner breakdown (control families):
- IAM / Access Controls: Marissa Cole (will pull role inventories, SSO configs, ACL exports)
- Key Management & Encryption: Karthik Iyer (KMS rotation records, envelope keys)
- Logging & Monitoring: Marissa Cole (retention policy, sample log extracts)
- Network / Infra Architecture: Karthik Iyer (network diagram, VPC config, peering docs)

I've attached a simple CSV with filenames we expect to collect and current owner assignments. If anyone sees gaps, flag them. We'll collect the artifacts in a gated folder and export a read-only link.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: control-owners.csv
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eleanor Rigby <eleanor.rigby@riverside-audit.com>
Date: 2027-08-03T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ mapping + artifacts for upcoming audit (Riverside / AcmeHealth)

Sofia / Marissa — attaching the first-pass CAIQ mapping (caiq_mapping_draft.xlsx) and an updated system architecture diagram (sys_arch_diagram_v2.pdf). Notes on a couple of controls Eleanor flagged in our last audit call:
- CCSK-13 (Key rotation): Attached KMS rotation export covers 12 months; we will redact KMS key material but include rotation timestamps and operator IDs.
- NET-04 (Network segmentation): Diagram shows VPC boundaries and internal routing; I'll add a short narrative for segmentation enforcement.

I've uploaded the artifacts to our secure ShareFile staging folder. Link: https://redwood-secure.sharefile.com/s/caiq-delivery-2027 (read-only access for Riverside reviewers).

Karthik
Staff Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
attachments: caiq_mapping_draft.xlsx, sys_arch_diagram_v2.pdf
From: Eleanor Rigby <eleanor.rigby@riverside-audit.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Chen <mike.chen@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ mapping + artifacts for upcoming audit (Riverside / AcmeHealth)

Thanks team — this is helpful. I can confirm the list for escrow: system architecture diagrams, KMS rotation logs (redacted as needed), and historical retention logs for 6–12 months. Two quick asks before we consider the escrow folder final:
1) Can you provide a signed artifact-escrow addendum (DocuSign is fine) that names Riverside as temporary reviewer and limits access to the audit window?
2) For the KMS rotation export, please include a short README that explains fields and any redaction policy.

If you can get the signed addendum and the README into the ShareFile folder by 2027-08-06, Riverside will schedule the CAIQ review session for 2027-08-16.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that accelerates anything.

Best,
Eleanor
Senior Auditor, Riverside Compliance
attachments: none
